responsibility: This definition module exposes the generated parser entry point for mc pass 5. Its CompilationUnit routine is the driver hook for the final parsing stage that builds procedure bodies and module initialization statement trees for implementation and program modules.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface file for pass 5, exposing only the CompilationUnit routine that callers invoke. Unlike mcp5.bnf, it contains no generated grammar or semantic-action code for body parsing.
